name: Mathias Krieger

education.notes: German secondary school in Mettingen, NRW.
Confirmed across The Org / search-derived summaries. Roan's hint mentioned Imperial College London but verified records point to KCL.

keyDecisions: Ran a small operating business in parallel with his KCL undergrad — got real P&L reps in his teens / early 20s instead of doing pure internships.
lessons: Running anything with a P&L during student years builds founder instinct that pure internships do not.
A German SME background is a legitimate substitute for VC / consulting CV polish — operating reps compound.
careerSteps.notes: German SME / lifestyle brand. Overlapped with his BSc at KCL (2014–2018) and ran ~1 year post-graduation.

keyDecisions: Started an outdoor-advertising venture (selling ad space on the side of delivery vans) in London — first venture-track attempt before HIVED.
Used Vanvas to learn the UK startup ecosystem and the logistics-adjacent space that became HIVED's domain.
lessons: An early venture that doesn't break out can still be the dataset for picking the next one — Vanvas literally taught Krieger about vans as a delivery surface.
First ventures are mostly about acquiring the right adjacencies for the second one.
careerSteps.notes: UK outdoor advertising startup that monetised the sides of delivery vans. Exact dates and outcome not publicly disclosed; Crunchbase entry exists. Domain proximity to last-mile delivery is the throughline into HIVED.

keyDecisions: Co-founded HIVED in 2021 with Murvah Iqbal — a London-based fully-electric parcel-delivery network competing with incumbent couriers.
Met co-founder Iqbal on a university trip to Silicon Valley — the geography that produced the network density mattered.
Started by literally delivering parcels themselves on bikes to learn the operations before scaling — founder-as-operator wedge.
Targeted premium retail brands (Zara, John Lewis, Nespresso) first, where sustainability mandates create willingness-to-pay.
Took Co-CEO + CPO seat alongside Iqbal — specialised on product / tech stack underpinning the fleet.
lessons: Climate-tech in a commoditised market (parcels) wins by being a tech-driven logistics operator, not just an EV-fleet operator.
Anchor enterprise customers with sustainability mandates are the wedge that funds the harder logistics-tech build.
Germany → KCL → London-founder is a viable early-career path for European founders chasing capital and customer density.
Doing the gritty operations yourself first (delivering on bikes) earns the right to automate / scale later.
careerSteps.notes: Founded 2021. Raised approximately $56.8M cumulative, including a $42M Series B in July 2025. Serves enterprise retail clients in the UK. Forbes 30 Under 30 Europe (Technology) class.

outcomes.currentStatus: Co-Founder & Co-CEO (CPO-track) of HIVED, a London-based sustainable parcel-delivery network. Raised ~$56.8M to date including a $42M Series B in July 2025.

lessons.lesson: Germany → KCL undergrad → first venture that fails-forward (Vanvas) → second venture in the adjacency (HIVED) is a clean European founder ladder.
lessons.source: Synthesised from Crunchbase, The Org, Tech.eu and Startups.co.uk coverage.

lessons.lesson: Proprietary tech-driven logistics differentiates in a commoditised delivery market while serving corporate sustainability mandates.
Operator reps in a small family/SME business during university are a legitimate substitute for VC or consulting CV polish.
lessons.source: Inferred from Lust Auf Lebensart overlap with KCL.

lessons.lesson: Meeting your co-founder on a university trip beats a cold intro — concentrated time abroad with peers is one of the highest-yield co-founder-discovery formats.
lessons.source: Krieger / Iqbal met on a KCL trip to Silicon Valley.
